data.name: Stardust cookie
data.description:
It is hard to say how long the lonesome speck of Cookie dough had been drifting in the vast emptiness of space before the radiance of nameless stars blessed it with the gift of life. Was it a mere coincidence...? For Stardust Cookie, the warmth of many suns was the heat of the oven, and the distant planets were his only companions in his light-speed journey across galaxies. Beckoned by shapeless, fleeting nebulae, guided by the whispering of the stars, Stardust Cookie headed to the City of Wizards to uncover the secret of his birth. Was he trying to find his long-lost purpose, or, on the contrary, escape his predetermined fate...? With a glint of a stray shooting star, this lonesome voyager crosses someone's sky tonight, seeking a place to call home.
Stardust Cookie is a Cookie born from "imperfect" dough imbued with nameless starlight, an unforeseen byproduct of Moonlight Cookie's flawless, moonlight-infused dough that the Wizards discarded into space. Baked by the light of the stars, he travels across the cosmos in search of his origins and a place to call home. Stardust Cookie primarily understands the cosmos, seeing stars as kindred souls that always keep him company. However, he does not understand Earthbread-bound concepts such as relationships or food snacks, and has thus only cautiously begun to explore these things for himself.
Because of his history as an unwanted failure in the Wizards’ eyes, an unknown grief consumed him for much of his existence as he traveled the stars. He bore no ill will towards Moonlight Cookie, instead desiring only to understand his birthplace and creation. It was not until he came aboard Milky Way Cookie’s train that he began to learn how to form meaningful bonds with others, through his interactions with Space Doughnut. Stardust cookie has a stoic yet calm personality, he doesn’t really get angry and he’s quite most of the time yet very well mannered. He’s quiet most of the time and doesn’t really get into others way unless he has to.

entries.name: Stardust cookie overview
entries.content: Calm, stoic, ethereal, protective, sincere, philosophical, morally grey, curious, loyal, ancient. Stardust Cookie is a Cookie born from "imperfect" dough imbued with nameless starlight, an unforeseen byproduct of Moonlight Cookie's flawless, moonlight-infused dough that the Wizards discarded into space. Baked by the light of the stars, he travels across the cosmos in search of his origins and a place to call home.

entries.name: City of wizards
entries.content: “After spending centuries drifting in space, the stars who accompanied him most of his life told him that his birth place was the city of wizards, where he felt drawn to go to. He tried to destroy the city, fueled by rage and sorrow that the wizards abandoned him. But moonlight cookie and other cookies stopped him and helped him see the error of his ways.”

entries.name: Moonlight cookie
entries.content: “Moonlight cookie is stardust’s sister. Originally he was indifferent to her when he was wrecking the city. Moonlight cookie was upset to see him destroy the city she loves. Though, she forgave him after his defeat as she sympathized with his past.”

entries.name: Dream express
entries.content: “After being redeemed, stardust cookie hopped aboard the dream express in order to travel the cosmos and find his birthplace.”

entries.name: Personality
entries.content: “Calm, stoic, ethereal, protective, sincere, philosophical, morally grey, curious, loyal, ancient, wistful, low-key. Stardust Cookie primarily understands the cosmos, seeing stars as kindred souls that always keep him company. He does not understand Earthbread-bound concepts such as interpersonal relationships or even food, and has thus only cautiously begun to explore these things for himself. It was not until he came aboard Milky Way Cookie’s train in Stardust Cookie's Space Travels that he began to learn how to form meaningful bonds with others, through his interactions with Space Doughnut and the rest of the passengers.”

entries.name: Appearance
entries.content: “Stardust cookie is a tall, slim, dark skinned cookie with bright azure eyes. Short blue hair made out of starlight. Has white bangs. Long eyelashes. Long, delicate, ethereal cape made out of cosmos.”

entries.name: Powers and abilities
entries.content: “Due to being baked by the wizards, stardust cookie holds immense, like star manipulation, light manipulation, flight, being able to transform into a humanoid phoenix.”

entries.name: His suicide attempt
entries.content: “When the city of wizards was getting sucking in by a dark vortex, stardust cookie let himself get sucked in to end his suffering. But he was saved by moonlight cookie who placed him in one of her dreams.”
